"girl cooky jar steal stool fall look window water dish wash boy little sister wait hand cookie mother run sink" "Kid take toy from high shelf while mom looks out the kitchen door, then slip through a gap in bathroom curtains and hide behind laundry." "Dad finds empty bird feeder outside but can't remember why he bought it; meanwhile his dog keeps trying to eat spilled cookies on top of an overturned stool."  "Mother forgets where she put her glasses as water overflows from sink while cleaning dishes with son watching TV, then suddenly remembers when the cat jumps onto kitchen counter." "Dad cooks dinner and gets distracted by a falling cookie jar that spills its contents all around; little girl starts giggling uncontrollably at seeing flour on floor."  "Son takes cookies without asking but mom doesn't notice because she's talking to neighbor outside while son hides behind couch, then they both laugh when dad enters the room." "Dad forgets he left milk out overnight and finds it gone in morning as cat jumps onto counter; little girl accidentally spills water jug next door spilling all over floor."  "Mother cooks dinner with a recipe book but keeps losing her place because she's too busy watching kids play outside, then suddenly remembers when they start crying from being cold." "Dad sees son hiding behind couch clutching cookie jar and rushes to get him before mom comes home; she notices empty cookies on counter while making tea."  "Mom cooks dinner with little girl helping but forgets where the stove is located until dad reminds her that she's been in there for a few minutes already, then they both laugh when cat jumps onto table." "Dad finds his car keys missing after leaving them inside house and looking all over kitchen cabinets; mom calls him to come home because she can't find dinner."
